'''Erik Frantz''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[August 2000 Normal tournament]] on 3 August 2000 with [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|RalOps / Troopers]], according to David Marincic's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1101">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-07-normal-il-8-3-00d1101/ normal-il-8-3-00], DeckTech (David "Wedge659" Marincic, 7 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-07-normal-il-8-3-00d1101/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
